description: Sana Industries Limited was established in 1988 to manufacture man-made blended fibre yarns and became a member of the Karachi Stock Exchange in 1989. It describes itself as an entity of the Sanaulla group of companies, and its spinning capacity has grown from 12,000 spindles at inception to 30,720 spindles, with its factory at B-186, H.I.T.E., Hub, Balochistan. The company presents itself as an innovator in new yarn products in the Pakistani market.
